name: Disk free-space shortfall investigation
goal: Find where ~50 GiB went (prune removed ~103 GiB from roleplaying-agents .git; df free rose ~50 GiB); record answer in a findings doc; delete/change nothing.

tasks.name: Measure and explain the shortfall (R1-R7)
tasks.description: No tests required: read-only investigation; only output is a findings doc. Exact commands: human plan Task 1 Steps 1-11. Raw output + stderr per step in /private/tmp/disk-shortfall/ (no 2>/dev/null); every command's exit appended to exits.txt; failed tool = 'not measured' row citing .err. Steps 6 and 8 run_in_background, timeout 1800000. Rank candidates by measured GiB. NOTHING deleted/moved/killed/unmounted/reconfigured; no sudo; git status with GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0.

steps.description: R1/R7: df, diskutil info Data, diskutil apfs list, ra status-before
steps.command: mkdir -p /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && date > stamp-1.txt; df -h / /System/Volumes/Data > df.txt 2> df.err; echo "df=$?" >> exits.txt; diskutil info /System/Volumes/Data > apfsinfo.txt 2> apfsinfo.err; echo "diskutil-info=$?" >> exits.txt; diskutil apfs list > apfs.txt 2> apfs.err; echo "apfs-list=$?" >> exits.txt; GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents status --short > ra-status-before.txt 2>&1; echo "status-before=$?" >> exits.txt; cat exits.txt
steps.expected: 4 exits recorded; note Data free (df), Container Free Space + Volume Used Space (diskutil info), per-volume Capacity Consumed.

steps.description: R1: purgeable (JXA important-usage minus available) + APFS and TM snapshots
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && osascript -l JavaScript -e 'ObjC.import("Foundation");var u=$.NSURL.fileURLWithPath("/System/Volumes/Data");var r=u.resourceValuesForKeysError(["NSURLVolumeAvailableCapacityKey","NSURLVolumeAvailableCapacityForImportantUsageKey"],null);JSON.stringify(ObjC.deepUnwrap(r))' > purgeable.txt 2> purgeable.err; echo "purgeable=$?" >> exits.txt; diskutil apfs listSnapshots /System/Volumes/Data > snapshots-apfs.txt 2> snapshots-apfs.err; echo "listSnapshots=$?" >> exits.txt; tmutil listlocalsnapshots / > snapshots-tm.txt 2> snapshots-tm.err; echo "tmutil=$?" >> exits.txt; cat purgeable.txt purgeable.err snapshots-apfs.txt snapshots-tm.txt
steps.expected: Purgeable GiB = important - available; nonzero purgeable exit = 'not measured' citing purgeable.err; both snapshot lists recorded.

steps.description: R2: deleted-but-open files, sum, flagged paths
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && lsof +L1 > lsof-L1.txt 2> lsof-L1.err; echo "lsof=$?" >> exits.txt; wc -l lsof-L1.txt; awk 'NR>1 {s+=$7} END {printf "bytes=%d GiB=%.2f\n", s, s/1073741824}' lsof-L1.txt > lsof-L1-sum.txt; cat lsof-L1-sum.txt; grep -n -e '\.pack' -e '\.idx' -e tmp_pack_ -e roleplaying-agents lsof-L1.txt > lsof-L1-flags.txt; echo "flags-grep=$?" >> exits.txt; cat lsof-L1-flags.txt
steps.expected: Sum recorded; lsof exit 1 + no rows = none; flags-grep exit 1 = no flagged paths; holder = cols 1-2.

steps.description: R3: staging total + all-size split by link count
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && date > stamp-4.txt; du -sk /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.tmp.driveupload > driveupload-du.txt 2> driveupload-du.err; echo "staging-du=$?" >> exits.txt; find /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.tmp.driveupload -type f -exec stat -f '%z %l %i %N' {} + > driveupload-all.txt 2> driveupload-all.err; echo "staging-find=$?" >> exits.txt; awk '{k=($2==1)?"links=1":"links>1"; s[k]+=$1; n[k]++} END {for (k in s) printf "%s files=%d GiB=%.2f\n", k, n[k], s[k]/1073741824}' driveupload-all.txt > driveupload-bylinks.txt; cat driveupload-du.txt driveupload-bylinks.txt
steps.expected: Total + links=1 / links>1 GiB recorded (all files, no size filter).

steps.description: R3: >50 MB staged files + magic bytes (PACK=git pack; 'SQLite format 3'=db)
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && awk '$1 > 52428800' driveupload-all.txt | sort -rn > driveupload-big.txt; wc -l driveupload-big.txt; for f in $(awk '{print $4}' driveupload-big.txt); do printf '%s ' "$f"; head -c 16 "$f" | tr -c '[:print:]' '.'; echo; done > driveupload-magic.txt 2>&1; cat driveupload-big.txt driveupload-magic.txt

steps.description: R3: locate other link of each big staged file under $HOME (prune staging + CloudStorage); run_in_background timeout 1800000; skip with 'no large staged files' if driveupload-big.txt empty
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && bash -c 'set -f; expr=$(awk "NR>1{printf \" -o \"} {printf \"-inum %s\", \$3}" driveupload-big.txt); find /Users/roberthyatt -xdev \( -path /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.tmp.driveupload -o -path /Users/roberthyatt/Library/CloudStorage \) -prune -o -type f \( $expr \) -exec stat -f "%i %z %N" {} + > otherlinks.txt 2> otherlinks.err; echo "otherlinks=$?" >> exits.txt'; cat otherlinks.txt; awk '{print $3}' driveupload-big.txt | sort -u > big-inodes.txt; awk '{print $1}' otherlinks.txt | sort -u > found-inodes.txt; comm -23 big-inodes.txt found-inodes.txt > unfound-inodes.txt; wc -l unfound-inodes.txt
steps.expected: Other paths recorded; unfound inodes listed; permission errors in otherlinks.err = stated limit.

steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && du -sh "/Users/roberthyatt/Library/Application Support/Google/DriveFS" /Users/roberthyatt/Library/CloudStorage > drivefs-du.txt 2> drivefs-du.err; echo "drivefs-du=$?" >> exits.txt; find "/Users/roberthyatt/Library/Application Support/Google/DriveFS" -maxdepth 3 -type d -name 'content_cache' -exec du -sh {} + > drivefs-cache.txt 2> drivefs-cache.err; echo "drivefs-cache=$?" >> exits.txt; cat drivefs-du.txt drivefs-du.err drivefs-cache.txt
steps.expected: Sizes recorded; missing path in .err is a finding.

steps.description: R5: known consumers + $HOME depth-1 GiB; run_in_background timeout 1800000
steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && du -sh /Users/roberthyatt/Backups /Users/roberthyatt/.config/superpowers/conversation-archive /Users/roberthyatt/.config/superpowers/conversation-index /Users/roberthyatt/.codex/sessions /Users/roberthyatt/.claude/projects /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents/.git > known-du.txt 2> known-du.err; echo "known-du=$?" >> exits.txt; du -x -d 1 -g /Users/roberthyatt > home-d1.txt 2> home-d1.err; echo "home-du=$?" >> exits.txt; sort -rn home-d1.txt | head -25
steps.expected: Recorded; compare to docs/reviews/2026-10-11-disk-usage-findings.md; note children grown >=5 GiB.

steps.description: R6: write docs/reviews/2026-10-12-disk-shortfall-findings.md: (1) gap GiB arithmetic ~103 removed - 50 gained - 2.7 mirror = ~50, each term sourced, + current df/diskutil; (2) candidate table (purgeable, APFS snapshots, deleted-open, Drive staging links=1 vs links>1 + other-link locations, Drive store/content_cache, other growth): measured GiB, evidence file, gap share; ranked by GiB; (3) unexplained remainder stated plainly; (4) options+risks as operator decisions only; (5) limits: no sudo, timestamps (staging changes live), exits.txt, 'not measured' rows

steps.command: cd /private/tmp/disk-shortfall && GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git -C /Users/roberthyatt/Code/roleplaying-agents status --short > ra-status-after.txt 2>&1; diff ra-status-before.txt ra-status-after.txt; echo "diff=$?"
steps.expected: diff=0; nonzero recorded as other-session activity.
